text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.'s debut race. Witnessing her 
overwhelming strength, the crowd buzzed 
with anticipation, hailing her as a future 
Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace's training gained even more 
intensity! However—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace's friends were feeling down 
after losing their own debut races. They 
confessed how painful it was to witness 
the brilliance of extraordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather than wasting words, now was the 
time to move forward. She would definitely 
win and bring hope to her friends. 
Katsuragi Ace made up her mind.
